test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A work can be completed by N men in 15 days. 5 men leave the work after 3 days. The remaining work was completed in 18 days. What is the value of N?
solution:
Given:- 

N men can complete the work in 15 days, 

Formula used:- 

work done = efficiency × time

Calculation:- 

Let the efficiency of 1 man be ' E ',

Total work done by N men = N × E × 15 = 15NE

Total work done by N men in 3 days = 3NE

After 3 days 5 men left the work. Remaining workers = N - 5

The remaining work is completed in 18 days by (N - 5) workers,

⇒ 3NE + 18 × (N - 5)× E = 15 NE

⇒ 18(N - 5) = 12N

⇒ 18N - 90 = 12N

⇒ 6N = 90

⇒ N = 15

**The required value of N is 15**.
